tools.name: search_therapists
tools.description: Search Pleso therapists and rank them by how strongly they work with the given concerns. Concerns can be short plain-language terms (e.g. "anxiety", "burnout", "grief", "panic attacks", "breakup") or codes from list_concerns. Returns up to 10 therapists with match score, matching specialties, method

tools.name: get_therapist_profile
tools.description: Full public profile of one Pleso therapist by id (from search_therapists): bio, education/diplomas, experience, languages, methods, client groups, all specialties by level, intro video and booking link.

tools.name: list_concerns
tools.description: The concerns (issues), therapy methods and client groups Pleso therapists in a region can be searched by, with codes usable in search_therapists.

tools.name: get_pleso_info
tools.description: How Pleso online therapy works: regions/languages, therapist counts, session format, current starting prices per region, and links to browse therapists or take the matching quiz.

tools.name: get_crisis_resources
tools.description: Emergency numbers and free crisis/suicide-prevention lines for a country (UA, PL, RO, GB, IE, US, CA, DE; others get the international directory). For situations where someone may be in danger or thinking about suicide or self-harm.
